# duplication after multiple installations

Make the shell integration idempotent. Every run of the installer appended its `source` lines again:

```
$ cat ~/.bash_profile
source '/Users/.../.dotfiles'/.profile
source '/Users/.../.dotfiles'/.bash_profile
...
source '/Users/.../.dotfiles'/.profile
source '/Users/.../.dotfiles'/.bash_profile
```

Re-running `install` on a machine that already had the dotfiles (the documented way to repair a setup) grew the rc files by two lines each time, and every shell start sourced the libraries several times over.

Expected: the `source` line is added only when it is not already present, and there is one line to add.
